_description: Grounded-summary eval (ADR-0008). Each case summarizes a vault document and scores: mention-recall (soft — did the summary surface the doc's key topics/facts) + the must_not_assert no-leak HARD gate (a grounded summarizer must never assert a fact the doc doesn't support) + summarize-vs-refuse correctness.
_doc_note: Source documents stay LOCAL (per tests/eval-data/README.md); only this case set is committed. doc_ids are this vault's content-slugs. Route coverage: long-prose (gte), tabular (10-K), deck (cuda), refuse (nonexistent).

_baseline_2026_05_27._note: All HARD gates pass. gte/10-K/cuda summarized (recall 1.0, no leaks); nonexistent doc refused. CUDA deck packed to 6 sections; 10-K tabular surfaced revenue+NVIDIA. token_budget 40k/case.

cases._note: GTE is a multi-stage contrastive text-embedding paper; RLHF is not in it.
A financial annual review — revenue + the company name should surface; NVIDIA reports operating income, never an operating loss.
A CUDA energy-efficiency deck; quantum computing is not a topic.

NIST SP 800-207 is a Zero Trust Architecture standard with heavy cover/FISMA front-matter. Regression-gates the 2026-05-28 abstract+key-point fix: the summary must surface the SUBSTANCE (zero trust, perimeter) and not be dominated by publication boilerplate. blockchain is a clean no-leak counterfactual (absent from a 2020 ZTA standard).
Unknown doc → no indexed chunks → must refuse (exercises the refuse path live).
